# dokploy_application (Data Source)

Fetches a single application from Dokploy by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The application ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `app_name` (String) The internal app name (used for Docker naming).
- `auto_deploy` (Boolean) Whether auto-deploy is enabled.
- `branch` (String) The branch to deploy from.
- `build_path` (String) The build path within the repository.
- `build_type` (String) The build type (nixpacks, dockerfile, etc.).
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the application.
- `description` (String) The description of the application.
- `dockerfile` (String) The Dockerfile path.
- `domains` (Attributes List) List of domains attached to the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `environment_id` (String) The environment ID the application belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the application (same as application_id).
- `mounts` (Attributes List) List of volume mounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mounts))
- `name` (String) The name of the application.
- `owner` (String) The repository owner.
- `ports` (Attributes List) List of port mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `registry_id` (String) The registry ID for the Docker image.
- `replicas` (Number) The number of replicas.
- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `server_id` (String) The server ID where deployed.
- `source_type` (String) The source type (github, docker, etc.).
- `status` (String) The current status of the application.

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_type` (String) The certificate type.
- `host` (String) The domain host.
- `https` (Boolean) Whether HTTPS is enabled.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the domain.
- `path` (String) The path prefix.
- `port` (Number) The port to route traffic to.


<a id="nestedatt--mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mounts`

Read-Only:

- `host_path` (String) The host path.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the mount.
- `mount_path` (String) The mount path inside the container.
- `type` (String) The mount type.
- `volume_name` (String) The volume name.


<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the port mapping.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol (tcp/udp).
- `published_port` (Number) The published (external) port.
- `target_port` (Number) The target (internal) port.
